messages:
rosa: quick note from a screenreader run on the Settings drawer — a couple of ordering/focus things.

chris: thanks, what did you see?

rosa: summary: 1) when drawer opens NVDA says each form field then finally the heading 'Settings' (order feels backwards). 2) focus lands on the close button instead of the first interactive control, which forces an extra tab. 3) keyboard users can tab out to page behind drawer.

chris: repro steps?

rosa: open drawer via gear icon or 'g' shortcut. NVDA reads: "Textbox, Combo box, Settings". The DOM inserts the heading after fields (we render heading visually with CSS but DOM order is fields then heading).

dev-bot: accessibility scan: detected DOM order mismatch (landmark-order) and missing focus trap for drawer id=drawer-settings. Report 81f2.

chris: ok easy wins: move heading markup so it's the first element in the drawer DOM, or use aria-labelledby on the container pointing to the visible heading id. Also ensure the heading has role="heading" and proper level.

rosa: agree. For focus, set initialFocus to the first field or a hidden skip link target. Also set inert on main content while drawer open to prevent tabbing behind.

a11y-review: note: prefer focus moving to primary action or first focusable control rather than close button. Document behaviour in PR.

chris: patch plan: 1) reorder heading into DOM start, 2) call focus() on first input on open, 3) add inert attribute to main when drawer open, 4) add aria-hidden on decorative SVGs in the drawer to reduce noise. Will include small unit test for focus trap.

rosa: sweet. also check contrast of placeholder text in inputs (seems low on dim theme). quick token swap to --text-muted-strong should fix.

chris: will include contrast tweak. ETA PR this afternoon. tagging @rosa for quick verify after merge.

dev-bot: CI will run axe checks and keyboard interaction tests for drawer components on merge.

rosa: thanks team — much better DX for keyboard & screen reader users once this lands.
